slides.title: Drone strike hits a displacement camp
slides.body: Hayiq Jari 2 IDP camp, Amhara. Addis Standard, Oct 30, 2026

slides.title: civilians killed, camp residents say
slides.body: Including children, women and elderly people. Residents said 22 more were injured on Oct 29.

slides.title: strikes, about 15 minutes apart
slides.body: A witness said the camp was hit at least five times from around 11 a.m. while people were in their shelters.

slides.title: displaced people live in the camp
slides.body: Many fled Wollega and West Shewa in Oromia, some in 2022. Residents said aid had largely stopped.

slides.title: Not independently verified
slides.body: The accounts come from residents. The report does not say who carried out the strike, and no official response was reported.

slides.title: Protect displaced civilians. Investigate independently.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Addis Standard via allAfrica, Oct 30, 2026 (camp residents)
